meta.title: A buyer with two companies sees only the current company's events
gaps: Switch between the two companies and compare that each Events list contains only that company's events, because no company IDs are provided for switch_company.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Switch between the two companies and compare that each Events list contains only that company's events, because no company IDs are provided for switch_company.

steps.note: Open the buyer's Events list, the subject of the test.
Verify the Events list rendered without an error and exposes the Create Event control.

args.need: provide the two QA company IDs, switch to the other company, verify its Events list contains only that company's events, then switch back and verify the original list is restored

steps.note: The catalog requires explicit company IDs and has no row-level assertion for company ownership.
Confirm the Events list is rendered after the tester completes the company-switch portion.
